title: Papa’s Spectacles
introduction: ‘Papa’s Spectacles’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects misplaced spectacles, searching through familiar places, noticing what is close at hand, family help and gratitude, ordering and comparison. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
